title: Intake mode :chg and verification from verified/master

story.i_want_to: treat a chg-enrolled repo as having no PR route
story.so_that: the PR path is closed for that repo and verification reads the trunk verifier's verdict

rationale: PRD §3 item 3 and §7. The forcing function on loopctl's side.

acceptance_criteria.description: Loopctl.Intake.Source.mode accepts :chg beside :pr. Enrolling or switching a source to :chg requires a change_events_secret.
MergePrecondition refuses any evaluation for a :chg source with 409 change_protocol_enrolled, naming chg submit as the route.
Story verification for a :chg source passes its CI-evidence input only when the current binding's landed sha is an ancestor of verified/master (compare by sha) and no reverted event follows it.
A compare call that times out or errors answers unevaluated with Retry-After; it is never read as a pass.

test_cases.name: not yet verified
preconditions: landed sha not an ancestor of verified/master (mocked forge)

technical_notes: #984 removes :thread from the same enum; whichever lands second resolves the conflict.
Every forge call authenticates with the tenant's own GitHub token (#936).
